summary: Explored the git extension's ChangesPanel.svelte and surrounding code to investigate the header text and file expansion behavior. Found that header wording was already changed in the registry's working copy (from 'N repository change(s)' to 'N change(s)') and that file rows are currently only expandable when an agent-generated patch exists for them, which the user flagged as not intended.
decisions: Remove the limitation that only files with agent-authored patches are expandable in the Git panel; all changed files should be expandable via repository diffs instead of only thread-derived patches.
Scrub any docs, code comments, or commit messages that state or imply files are only expandable when an agent-generated patch exists.
errors: grep on path 'packages/git/server/git-service.ts' failed with ENOENT; the correct path is 'packages/git/src/server/git-service.ts'.
ripgrep regex with pattern 'invoke|commitContext|status(' failed to parse due to an unclosed group; retry used a simpler pattern.
